author: Jordy2067
quote:
GTA 6 is a pretty game that is engaging right from the beginning. If you are looking for a good game, it’s here, however, my issues are

The softening of the gta brand. This is a realistic game with a romance at its center. It’s interesting, but it’s not gta. Developers openly talking about being more sensitive goes against what this series is.

The 30 fps in 2026 is unacceptable.

The fact the game punishes you for engaging in normal gta behavior is mind boggling. This feels more like Red dead in modern day than it does the next installment of GTA

With my criticisms, the game is probably on its own an 8/10

However, the stunt with the disc, promising a physical release and then going back on their word is unforgivable. And that alone results in a 1/10. This could have been the greatest game of all time and that stunt alone would have negated all the hard word of the developers in my eyes. It single handily killed any excitement I had for this game.

It’s enjoyable, but it’s no GTA 5 or 4. It won’t be talked about in that level.

author: Jordy2067
quote:
Wolverine is a game that on paper was the easiest slam dunk imaginable. Give us a brutal, hack and slash epic set during his weapon x days, giving spotlight to wider x men lore and characters much like spider man 2018 did.

Insomniac however, decided they wanted to go half way on that concept and make the other half their own weird little fantasy. Weapon x is here, oh but it’s not the weapon x we know. Jean Grey, Sabertooth, Mystique and Mr Sinister are here, but they aren’t the versions of those characters who have been loved for decades. Oh and Wolverine is here, he’s the star, he’s James ‘Logan’ Howlett….. but not the one we know. In fact the very things that have made the character an icon have been stripped away and replaced with the Hollywood idea of a lead man. Wolverine is a team player, he’s emotionally intelligent and talks about his feelings, he apologizes constantly for small mistakes and worries about getting angry rather than eagerly awaiting the next fight. In plain and simple terms, this is not wolverine, this is an idealistic version of what a certain group of people who hate the traditional version of the character think Wolverine should be going forward. Why? Because they said so and screw anyone who doesn’t agree.

What we are left with, unfortunately, is a game that was made by a team that either doesn’t understand the character and lore of wolverine and the x men, or who do understand, decided it was problematic and felt it was their mission to change it. And I don’t know which one is worse. 

There is a difference between taking creative liberties and actively butchering stories and characters that mean so much to so many.

Many will laugh and call complaints like this over the top or sensitive. I don’t really care. Wolverine, the x men and all of marvel comics, are a huge part of people’s lives. Childhood, teens, young adulthood, middle age and beyond, these characters and stories are pillars for millions. A treasure chest that insomniac inherited and instead of respecting it, they changed it to suit their ideas and agendas. 

People have talked egregiously about the hand holding, the face models, the voice acting and the SBI involvement and those are all problems, but there’s nothing more I can add to the thousands of complaints that seem to get ignored by a studio that frame customer complaints as attacks on their mental health and would rather burn the game and it’s characters to the ground than listen to people who disagree with them. 

Marvel’s Wolverine gets a three because there is some good here. The game is very pretty, and it will bring some joy to people who do not care about the same things I do, but 300 million dollars for this is a mind blowing number and I fail to see where it went. 

There’s no hook, nothing to keep you pulling through the muck and no shining light.

And overall, the game continues the steady decline of insomniac ever since the first spider man game and at this point, I’m unfortunately starting to think that game was maybe a fluke.
